{"id":1826071599,"question_id":3834,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"8 months, 1 week","timestamp":1762787175,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"30 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1826071599/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Operations to Convert All Elements to Zero","memory":"222.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minOperations(vector<int>& nums) {\n        stack<int>st;\n        int opr = 0;\n\n        for(int i=0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++)\n        {   \n            while(!st.empty() and st.top() > nums[i])\n            {\n                st.pop();\n            }\n            \n            if(nums[i] == 0) continue;\n\n            if(st.empty() or (st.top() < nums[i]))\n            {\n                st.push(nums[i]);\n                opr++;\n            }\n        }\n    return opr;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-operations-to-convert-all-elements-to-zero","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1108}
